primary_goal: At least 100 paired positive events after endpoint and Agent attrition

minimum_unlock_gate.notes: Recalculate prospectively from outcome-blind operational rates and a prespecified paired-effect model. Do not tune to E4 test labels.

multiplicity: At most three primary comparisons with a frozen Holm or hierarchical procedure
not_a_power_claim: These projections do not prove 80% power for an unknown Agent effect; final simulation/analytic power must be frozen before E5 outcomes exist.
